chunks.head: look out for
chunks.note: look out for sb/sth = 小心提防、时时留神。
chunks.ex_en: Look out for cars when you cross the street.
chunks.ex_cn: 过马路时当心车。

chunks.head: play hookey
chunks.note: play hookey = 逃学(旧俚,几乎只用在此搭配);英式常说 play truant。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'玩耍'义,是固定搭配

chunks.ex_en: The boys decided to play hookey and go fishing.
chunks.ex_cn: 男孩们决定逃学去钓鱼。

chunks.head: break into
chunks.note: break into a laugh/song/tears = 突然大笑/唱起来/哭起来;另有'闯入'义。
chunks.ex_en: She broke into a laugh when she heard the joke.
chunks.ex_cn: 听到那个笑话,她突然大笑起来。

chunks.head: in time
chunks.note: in time (to do / for sth) = 来得及做某事;注意与 on time(准时)不同。
chunks.ex_en: We got to the station just in time to catch the train.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们正好赶上了那班火车。

chunks.head: get back
chunks.note: get back = 回到原处、返回;get back home = 回到家。
chunks.ex_en: I'll call you when I get back from work.
chunks.ex_cn: 我下班回来后给你打电话。

chunks.head: be through with
chunks.note: be through with sth = 把某事做完;也可指'与…断绝关系'。
chunks.ex_en: Are you through with your homework yet?
chunks.ex_cn: 你作业做完了吗?

chunks.head: stick to
chunks.note: stick to sth = 坚持某计划/规则,或固定使用某一种。
chunks.ex_en: Let's stick to our original plan.
chunks.ex_cn: 咱们还是按原计划来吧。

chunks.head: turn up one's nose at
chunks.note: turn up one's nose at sth = 因看不上而不屑一顾。
chunks.ex_en: She turned up her nose at the cheap gift.
chunks.ex_cn: 她对那份廉价礼物不屑一顾。

chunks.head: face to face
chunks.note: face to face = 当面、面对面;常与 meet/talk 连用。
chunks.ex_en: We finally met face to face after years of emails.
chunks.ex_cn: 通了多年邮件后,我们终于见了面。

chunks.head: shoulder to shoulder
chunks.note: shoulder to shoulder = 紧挨着,或喻并肩协作。
chunks.ex_en: The soldiers stood shoulder to shoulder.
chunks.ex_cn: 士兵们肩并肩地站着。

chunks.head: fool with
chunks.note: fool with sb/sth = 招惹某人、胡乱摆弄某物(口语)。
chunks.ex_en: Don't fool with that machine—it's dangerous.
chunks.ex_cn: 别乱动那台机器,很危险。

chunks.head: look out
chunks.note: Look out! = 当心!(常单用作警告);与 look out for(提防)略有区别。
chunks.ex_en: Look out! There's a car coming.
chunks.ex_cn: 当心!有车过来了。

chunks.head: find out
chunks.note: find out = 通过打听或调查得知某事。
chunks.ex_en: I want to find out the truth.
chunks.ex_cn: 我想查明真相。

chunks.head: make faces at
chunks.note: make a face / make faces at sb = 做鬼脸(逗弄或嘲弄)。
chunks.ex_en: The children made faces at each other and laughed.
chunks.ex_cn: 孩子们互相做鬼脸,笑作一团。

chunks.head: turn tail
chunks.note: turn tail (and run) = 转身逃跑(含胆怯意)。
chunks.ex_en: When the thief saw the police, he turned tail and ran.
chunks.ex_cn: 小偷一看到警察就掉头逃跑了。

chunks.head: have the heart to
chunks.note: 常用于否定:not have the heart to do sth = 不忍心做某事。
chunks.ex_en: She didn't have the heart to tell him the bad news.
chunks.ex_cn: 她不忍心把坏消息告诉他。

chunks.head: miss a trick
chunks.note: 常用否定 never miss a trick = 什么机会都不放过;miss a trick = 失了一着。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'把戏'义,指得手的机会

chunks.ex_en: A good salesman never misses a trick.
chunks.ex_cn: 优秀的推销员从不放过任何机会。

chunks.head: dare sb to do sth
chunks.note: I dare you to do sth = 我谅你不敢…(激将口吻)。
chunks.ex_en: I dare you to jump into the cold water.
chunks.ex_cn: 我谅你不敢跳进冷水里。

chunks.head: with one hand tied behind one's back
chunks.ipa: /wɪð wʌn hænd taɪd bɪˈhaɪnd wʌnz bæk/
chunks.note: do sth with one hand tied behind one's back = 不费吹灰之力就能做到。
chunks.ex_en: I could beat you at chess with one hand tied behind my back.
chunks.ex_cn: 下棋我闭着眼都能赢你。
occ: with one hand tied behind me

chunks.head: the knack of
chunks.note: get/have the knack of (doing) sth = 掌握做某事的窍门。
chunks.ex_en: It took me a while to get the knack of riding a bike.
chunks.ex_cn: 我花了好一阵才摸到骑车的窍门。

chunks.head: put off
chunks.note: put sb off = 用借口敷衍/支开某人(也有'推迟'义);本章出处为分离式(put me off),故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: Don't put me off with excuses.
chunks.ex_cn: 别拿借口搪塞我。

chunks.head: let off
chunks.note: let sb off = 放某人一马、不予惩罚;本章出处为分离式(let him off),故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: The teacher let him off with a warning.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师只给了他一个警告就放过了他。

chunks.head: have a good time
chunks.note: have a good time = 玩得尽兴;本章出处被 very 隔开(had a very good time),故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: We had a good time at the party.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们在聚会上玩得很开心。

chunks.head: play tricks on
chunks.note: play a trick / play tricks on sb = 对某人恶作剧、耍花招;本章出处为分离式(played me tricks),故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: The boys played tricks on their teacher on April Fools' Day.
chunks.ex_cn: 愚人节那天男孩们捉弄了老师。

chunks.head: in a fix
chunks.note: be in a fix = 处境为难;本章出处为 in the same fix,故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: I'm in a fix—I've lost my keys.
chunks.ex_cn: 我遇到麻烦了——钥匙丢了。

chunks.head: as far as ... is concerned
chunks.note: 中间填人或事,表示从某方面来看;本章被内容词隔开,故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: As far as I'm concerned, the plan is fine.
chunks.ex_cn: 就我而言,这个计划没问题。

chunks.head: tell on
chunks.note: tell on sb = 告某人的状、揭发;本章出处为分离式(tell my big brother on you),故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: Don't tell on me, please!
chunks.ex_cn: 求你别告发我!

chunks.head: gone with
chunks.gloss: (老式)…出什么事了、…跑哪儿去了
chunks.note: what's gone with sb = what has happened to sb(老式美语,带不耐烦语气);同族:what's become of sb / what's come over sb。此处 gone 非'走了、不见了'义。
chunks.ex_en: What's gone with my keys? I just had them!
chunks.ex_cn: 我钥匙上哪儿去了?刚才还在的!

chunks.head: make out
chunks.note: make out to do sth = 设法/得以做成(老式口语)。此处「make out to put me off」=设法把我岔开一会儿。非'辨认/看清'义,也非'进展如何'义。
chunks.ex_en: He made out to finish the work before dark.
chunks.ex_cn: 他设法在天黑前把活儿干完了。

chunks.head: take and
chunks.note: take and + 动词 = 美国地方话的强调说法,重点在'就这么去做/干脆去做',take 不表'拿'。此处「take and bounce a rock」=干脆拿石头砸。同族:up and + 动词。
chunks.ex_en: I'll just take and tell him myself.
chunks.ex_cn: 我干脆自己去告诉他。
